input.body:
Hi there! I'm sorry you're having trouble with the password reset email.

To reset your password, please go to Settings > Security and click Reset Password. A reset link will be emailed to you and expires in one hour. 

If you're not seeing the email, please check your spam or junk folder - sometimes these emails can end up there. If the reset link shows an error when you click it, it has likely expired, so just request a fresh one.

Note that password reset is only available on the web version of our product.

If you're still not receiving the email after checking spam and requesting a new link, please let me know and I'll be happy to help further!

Best regards
